k1605:
A 2+1 apartment on Bulevardi Dyrrah, the main axis running through Durrës, opposite Bllaca.

The flat covers 88.42 m² and is arranged as two bedrooms, a living room with the kitchen, a bathroom and a balcony. It is on the third floor of an established building.

The balcony gives directly onto the boulevard, which is the point of an address like this: everything the town has is within walking distance and the transport runs past the door.

The layout is straightforward and suits a family, though the position is central enough that it is bought as an investment just as often.
k1607: A 65 m² one-bedroom flat on the eighth floor at Iliria, fitted out to an architect's design and light all day.
k1608:
A 1+1 apartment of 65 m² at Iliria, one of the parts of Durrës that people look at first because of how close the sea is.

Inside there is one bedroom, a living room with the kitchen and a bathroom. The flat is on the eighth floor and the building has a lift.

The fit-out was done to an architect's design rather than assembled piecemeal, and it shows in how the space is used. The height brings light through the flat for most of the day.

Shops, cafés and the beach are all within reach on foot, which is why flats in this pocket are bought to live in and to let in equal measure.
k1609: 2+1 apartment with garage at Pishat e Buta, Golem
k1610: An 87 m² two-bedroom flat a hundred metres from the sea at Golem, with a garage included.
k1611:
A 2+1 apartment at Pishat e Buta, the pine-backed stretch of Golem, a hundred metres from the water.

The flat covers 87 m² and holds two bedrooms, a living room with the kitchen and a bathroom. It is on the third residential floor.

A garage comes with it, which on this part of the coast matters more than it sounds: parking in season is the first thing owners here complain about.

The surroundings stay quiet outside the summer months, so it works as a family home as readily as a holiday flat or a летний rental.
k1612: 8,128 m² development plot at Spitallë, Durrës
k1613: Eight thousand square metres at Spitallë with room to extend to sixteen thousand, suited to industry or long-term development.
k1614:
A plot of 8,128 m² at Spitallë, the industrial belt north of Durrës.

The seller can extend the parcel to roughly 16,000 m², which is what separates this from most land on offer around the city: there is room to plan a site rather than fit a building onto a strip.

The area is given over to industry and agriculture rather than housing, and the scale suits a company buying for its own use or an investor holding for the longer term.

Nothing here is finished or built on, so what goes up is a matter for the buyer and the urban plan.
k1616: An 81 m² two-bedroom flat on the third floor of an established building, in a quiet central part of Durrës.
k1617:
A 2+1 apartment at Ish Rajoni, one of the settled central quarters of Durrës rather than a new development.

The flat measures 81 m²: two bedrooms, a living room with the kitchen and a bathroom, on the third floor.

The building is an older one and has been kept up. Daylight reaches the rooms through the day, and the streets around it are quiet while still being easy to get out of.

The mortgage paperwork is in order, which shortens the part of the purchase that usually takes longest here.
k1619: A 106 m² two-bedroom flat with two balconies on the fourth floor, in the Currila quarter of Durrës.
k1620:
A 2+1 apartment at Currila, the quarter along the northern shore of Durrës.

At 106 m² it is larger than most flats of this layout: two bedrooms, a living room with the kitchen, a bathroom and two balconies. It sits on the fourth floor and the building has a lift.

The extra floor area shows in the rooms rather than the hallway, and cross ventilation between the two balconies keeps the flat airy through the summer.

Currila is a settled address close to the sea and to the services of the town, and it is bought to live in more often than to let.
k1621: 1+1 apartment 300 m from the sea, Golem
k1622: A 64 m² one-bedroom flat on the fourth floor at Golem, three hundred metres from the beach.
k1623:
A 1+1 apartment at Golem, three hundred metres inland from the beach.

The flat covers 64 m², laid out as one bedroom, a living room with the kitchen and a bathroom, on the fourth residential floor.

That distance from the water is the useful part: close enough to walk down in the morning, far enough back that the noise of the beach bars stays where it is.

Golem fills up from June and empties again in September, so flats of this size here are usually either a holiday base or something let out through the season.
k1624: Furnished 2+1 apartment with sea view, Shkëmbi i Kavajës
k1625: An 80 m² two-bedroom flat 150 metres from the sea at Shkëmbi i Kavajës, furnished and with the ownership certificate issued.
k1626:
A 2+1 apartment at Shkëmbi i Kavajës, a hundred and fifty metres from the sea, with the water in view from the flat.

It measures 80 m² gross: two bedrooms, a living room with the kitchen and a bathroom, on the second floor.

The flat has been fully done up and furnished, down to the fittings, so nothing needs buying before it can be used or let.

The ownership certificate is issued. This is one of the busier holiday stretches of the Durrës coast, and a furnished flat with a sea view here does not sit empty in season.
k1627: Studio with a 17 m² veranda in a 2025 building, Golem
k1628: A 27 m² studio on the ground floor at Golem with a 17 m² veranda, furnished throughout, in a building finished in 2025.
k1629:
A studio at Golem in a building finished in 2025, on the ground floor.

The flat measures 27 m² gross and 24 m² net, with a veranda of a further 17 m² — which on a unit this size changes how it lives, since the veranda is where the summer is actually spent.

It has been furnished with some care: decorative plasterwork and painted finishes rather than the usual quick fit-out.

The ownership certificate has not been issued yet and is still being processed — worth knowing before making an offer. The beach is a few minutes away on foot.
k1630: South-facing studio with lift, Shkëmbi i Kavajës
k1631: A 34 m² studio on the fourth floor at Shkëmbi i Kavajës, facing south, on a side street away from the traffic.
k1632:
A studio at Shkëmbi i Kavajës, on a side street rather than the main coastal road.

It measures 34 m² gross and 29 m² net, arranged as a living room with the kitchen and a bathroom, on the fourth residential floor. The building has a lift.

The flat faces south, so light comes in for most of the day — which is not a given on this stretch, where many buildings sit close together.

Residents share a parking space, and the sea and the everyday shops are both a short walk off. It suits summer use or letting as easily as living in.
k1633: 2+1 apartment at Vala Park, Lagjja 18, Durrës
k1634: A 75 m² two-bedroom flat on the fourth floor near Vala Park, within walking distance of schools, shops and city transport.
k1635:
A 2+1 apartment near Vala Park in Lagjja 18, a residential part of Durrës that people move to for the everyday rather than the view.

The flat covers 75 m²: two bedrooms, a living room with the kitchen and a bathroom. It is on the fourth floor and not the top one, which spares it the roof.

The layout is plain and works — no space lost to corridors, and the rooms take furniture without argument.

Schools, supermarkets and the city bus routes are all within walking distance, which is what makes this an address for a family rather than for a season.
k1636: Two-level 60 m² duplex near the sea, Plazh
k1637: A 60 m² duplex over two levels in a managed residence at Plazh, fully rebuilt and delivered furnished.
k1638:
A duplex at Plazh, in a residence with proper management, close to the sea.

The unit totals 60 m² with 43.6 m² net over two levels. Downstairs there is the living area, a kitchen corner, a bathroom and a store room big enough for a single bed or a desk; upstairs a bedroom and a second store room that can take a wardrobe or whatever else is wanted.

It sits on the ground floor but raised about a metre above the ground, and it has been rebuilt from the wiring and plumbing up — new floors, new lighting, a steel structure for the upper level, new doors and windows.

It is handed over fully furnished, with new appliances supplied to order within ten days of the deal.
k1639: Compact 42 m² duplex with parking, Plazh
k1640: A 42 m² duplex over two levels at Plazh, rebuilt throughout, delivered furnished and with parking guaranteed.
k1641:
A duplex at Plazh in a managed residence, a short distance from the sea.

It totals 42 m² across two levels, with 27 m² net on the lower one. Downstairs sits the living area with a kitchen corner and the bathroom; the bedroom is upstairs.

The flat is on the ground floor, raised about a metre above the ground. It has been rebuilt from the services outwards — electrics, plumbing, floors, lighting, a steel structure for the upper level, new doors and windows.

The ownership certificate is in order and a parking space comes with it. It is handed over furnished, with new appliances supplied to order within ten days.
k1642: 2+1 apartment in the Desla Tower, Plazh, Durrës
k1643: A 2+1 apartment of 93.3 m² net on the third floor of the Desla Tower at Plazh, one of several units offered in the building.
k1644:
An apartment in the Desla Tower at Plazh, a tall modern building on the Durrës sea front.

This unit is a 2+1 on the third floor: 93.3 m² net and 110.74 m² total, with the living room and kitchen together, two bedrooms and a balcony.

Several other apartments in the same tower are on offer alongside it, at layouts from 1+1 upwards and on floors as high as the eighth, together with parking spaces on the lower level. Anyone comparing them is best doing it against the floor plans.

The building is run with security and management in place, and the height gives the upper flats a view along the coast.
k1645: 2+1 apartment with two bathrooms, third line from the sea, Plazh
k1646: A 110 m² two-bedroom flat on the sixth floor at Plazh, third line back from the sea, with two bathrooms and two balconies.
k1647:
A 2+1 apartment at Plazh, standing on the third line back from the water.

It measures 110 m² gross and 97 m² net: two bedrooms, a living room with the kitchen, two bathrooms and two balconies. The flat is on the sixth floor and the building has a lift.

Two bathrooms in a flat this size is the detail worth noting — most two-bedroom flats along this coast make do with one, and it tells when a family or a let is sharing them.

The third line is a compromise that works: the sea is a couple of minutes off, and the summer noise of the front row stays a street away.
k1648: 1+1 apartment on the seventh floor, Plazh Hekurudha
k1649: A 60 m² one-bedroom flat on the seventh floor in the Hekurudha part of Plazh, in a building with a lift.
k1650:
A 1+1 apartment in the Hekurudha part of Plazh, a settled residential pocket a short way back from the beach.

The flat covers 60 m² gross and 53 m² net: one bedroom, a living room with the kitchen and a bathroom. It is on the seventh residential floor and the building has a lift.

The height is the thing here — at this level the light comes in unobstructed through the day, which flats lower down in this neighbourhood do not get.

Shops, cafés and transport are all close, and a flat of this size in this position works either as a home or as something to let, in season or year round.
k1651: Large 2+1 apartment with two bathrooms, Ish URT, Durrës
k1652: A 145 m² two-bedroom flat on the first residential floor at Ish URT, with two bathrooms and two large balconies.
